note: The built core combines this repository's integration with two emulators: DuckStation as it stood at its last GPL-3.0 commit, which is the PlayStation, and ArcadeDuck, which is the arcade boards built out of a PlayStation and is itself derived from that same DuckStation commit under the GPL-3.0 only. The package is distributed under the GPL-3.0, which is both emulators' licence and the strongest term in it. Everything else it links is permissive and travels inside those terms: fmt, fast_float, simpleini, rapidyaml and Dear ImGui are MIT; xxHash, libchdr and Zstandard are BSD; zlib and minizip are under the zlib licence; the LZMA SDK is public domain. ArcadeDuck brings sound-chip and processor emulations of its own, each under the licence named beside it below: BSD-3-Clause for the parts that come from MAME (the M37710, the ADSP-2181, the MN10200, the ZSG-2 and the TMS57002), for ymfm and for the QSound HLE; MIT for Musashi's 68000 and for the Z80. No BIOS, no board firmware, no rom set and no game is part of this package - they are dumps the user supplies, and none ever enters this repository.

components.name: chimera-core-duckstation (integration)
components.license: MIT, and the emulators' terms (GPL-3.0) for patches/, patches-arcade/, waterbox/host.cpp and waterbox/audio-stream.cpp

components.name: DuckStation
components.note: Pinned at the last commit of DuckStation offered under the GPL-3.0 (2024-09-01). Later versions are under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and nothing from them is in this package. Its per-title database (data/resources/gamedb.yaml) is compiled into the core.

components.name: ArcadeDuck
components.note: The arcade boards: Sony ZN-1 and ZN-2, Namco System 11, Konami GV and GQ. A derivative of DuckStation's last GPL-3.0 commit, compiled whole beside it. Its record of the boards and their rom sets (data/resources/arcadedb.yaml) is compiled into the core. Its own notice is NOTICE in its repository, and the licences of what it bundles are in its THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt, which travels with this package.

components.name: ArcadeDuck third-party notices
components.note: ArcadeDuck's own list of what it bundles and under which terms. The parts of it this core compiles are the ADSP-2181 (from MAME, by way of modem-dsp-emu), the MN10200, ZSG-2 and TMS57002 adapted from MAME, and the ones named separately below.

components.name: Dear ImGui
components.note: Compiled because DuckStation's own files include it for their debug windows; no context is ever created and nothing is drawn with it.

components.name: glslang
components.license: BSD-3-Clause, BSD-2-Clause, MIT and Apache-2.0, with its generated parser under GPL-3.0 with the Bison exception
components.note: The compiler that turns the GLSL DuckStation writes for its Vulkan device into SPIR-V. Its front end and SPIR-V writer are compiled in, without the optimiser and without HLSL. Used only when the Renderer setting is vulkan-hw.

components.name: Vulkan Memory Allocator
components.note: One header, carried in DuckStation's tree beside the Khronos Vulkan headers (Apache-2.0) it is compiled against. Its licence is the comment at its top.
